close_reason: fixed: collapseThreads total returned correctly when was_capped=false; approximate lower bound returned when was_capped=true
description: When collapseThreads=true and the backend result set exceeds COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS (65536), the code sets total=None (email.rs line 701) and the response omits the 'total' field even when calculateTotal=true. RFC 8620 §5.5 only mandates 'total MUST be omitted when calculateTotal=false'; it does not require total to be present when calculateTotal=true. However, a client that sends calculateTotal=true expects to receive a total in the response; getting no total when calculateTotal=true is a silent failure from the client's perspective. The client cannot distinguish 'total is unavailable because of the cap' from 'server bug'. This should at minimum be documented as a known limitation; ideally the response should include a 'total' field with a note or return the best-effort count of collapsed IDs up to the cap.
title: Email/query collapseThreads: total not included even when calculateTotal=true and was_capped=false
